channel.title: KPFK - Voces de Libertad
channel.description: Voces de Libertad on KPFK 90.7 FM is a striking public affairs program hosted by Rodrigo Argueta that explores the complexities of grassroots resistance. The podcast provides a dedicated platform focusing on the deep-rooted political and revolutionary struggles within Mexico. Listeners can tune in to gain critical insights into community organizing, social justice movements, and the systemic fight for liberation. This program cuts through mainstream narratives to deliver authentic voices directly from the frontlines of activism.
